description: Emerald: start_here at session start, and the inbox's new rows before a prompt, each in full once per session and then a count (M47 U1, M51 U6). Silent in a folder that names no document. Run from the published emerald-mcp, pinned, through npx (M42 U4); where the host starts no plugin MCP server, the emerald-setup skill, from the plugin folder (M42 F8).

hooks.command: npx -y --prefer-offline -p emerald-mcp@0.1.5 emerald-hooks rows "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" inbox --match state=new --once-per-session
